def is_public_family(name: str) -> bool:
    """Check the name is come from public modules or not."""
    for n in name.split('.'):
        # Magic name
        if is_magic(n):
            continue
        # Local or private name
        if n.startswith('_'):
            return False
    return True

def is_magic(name: str) -> bool:
    """Check magic name."""
    name = name.rsplit('.', maxsplit=1)[-1]
    return name[:2] == name[-2:] == '__'
